rationale: Reference baseline and lineage root of the second front forward, not a candidate: the tip keeps the speed the prefix shows, whatever the flow does afterwards; no law of flow, oxygen or width, no overhang, no quench. Same numbers as the baseline of bass_front-wsp-v1, statement by statement, with the entries added by bass_front-wsp-v2 (speed.split, speed.pow_i, speed.kappa, over.tau_up_s, unc.flow_abs_cm_s, unc.flow_rel, unc.flow_w) switched off, so that its forecast is that of the first front forward. Data-informed candidates of bass_front-wsp-v2 are literal revisions of this release, so that the registry records them as revisions with development exposure.
